images.title: What is a context window?
images.subtitle: The amount of text an AI can hold in view at once, and what happens when it fills up.

images.title: A context window is a whiteboard with a fixed size

pairs.right: The token limit is set by the model

pairs.left: Everything for this shift goes on it
pairs.right: Everything for this request goes in it
Old text may be dropped or summarized
Text outside it can't be seen

images.note: A model takes in the whole board again for every reply.

images.title: The chat is sent again on every turn

items.label: Turn 1: 1 piece
items.text: Message 1 goes in. Reply 1 comes out.

items.label: Turn 2: 3 pieces
items.text: Message 1, reply 1 and message 2 go in.

items.label: Turn 3: 5 pieces
items.text: All of that goes in, plus reply 2 and message 3.

images.note: The model keeps nothing between turns by itself.

images.title: A pasted report can take nearly half the window
